Definition
[Integral curve of the normalized generalized gradient] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0465 1. apph:H.43\group Integral curves For $f\in \Vzero (C)$ and $f(x)=a$, an integral curve is a locally Lipschitz path $\gamma _x:[a,b] o C$ with $\gamma _x(a)=x$, $f(\gamma _x(s))<f_{\sup }$, and \[ (\dot\gamma _x)_+(s)= rac{ abla f(\gamma _x(s))}{| abla f(\gamma _x(s))|^2}. \] It is maximal when $f(b)=f_{\sup }$.
